pages.title: Wanderers
text: Eight gentle creatures are not tied to one land. You will meet them across the March, in the open, in the caves and at the edge of lava.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), and though none has a gift of its own, a bonded one can still take a voice at a totem and strengthen your magic (see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning)).
Several of their reagents grind into dye: see [reagents](reagents).

pages.title: Ash Hopper
text: A small, quick jerboa of the Steppe, the Crystal Fields and the Ember Wastes, in groups of two to four. **12 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Ash Tufts**.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Raw Game and up to 1 Rabbit Hide. Breed with **carrots or Steppe Grain**.

pages.title: Ridge Grazer
text: A small woolly mammoth of the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge and the Snow Fields. **26 health**, **2 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Grazer Wool** (light grey dye).
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **wheat**.

pages.title: Crag Bounder
text: An ibex of the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge, the Snow Fields and the Crystal Fields. **20 health**, **2 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Bounder Horns**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **wheat**.

pages.title: Dust Flitter
text: A little finch, the commonest flier in the March, in every land including the Shallows. **8 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Flitter Wings**.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Feathers. Breed with **wheat seeds or Steppe Grain**.

pages.title: Glimmer Moth
text: A pale green luna moth of the Crystal Fields, the Glimmer Ridge and the Reed Fen. **10 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Glimmer Dust** (cyan dye).
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 String and up to 1 Glowstone Dust. Breed with **Echo Blooms or any small flower**.

pages.title: Underground and by lava
text: Both lava dwellers turn up wherever the March has lava, in every land but the Shallows.

pages.title: Stone Grub
text: A caddis grub in a case of pebbles, of the dark caves under every land but the Shallows, two to four at a time. **10 health**, **4 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Grub Husks** (brown dye).
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Slimeball. Breed with **Lantern Caps or any mushroom**.

pages.title: Ember Drifter
text: A fire-bellied firefly that gathers by lava. **12 health**, **immune to fire**. Drops **1 to 2 Ember Motes** (red dye), an Ember reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Charcoal. Breed with **coal or charcoal**.

pages.title: Magma Creeper
text: A magma pangolin, slow and armoured, of the hot stone by lava. **22 health**, **6 armour**, **immune to fire**. Drops **1 to 2 Magma Scales** (orange dye), an Ember reagent. Magma Scales call the Slag Titan at the Slag Throne.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Magma Cream. Breed with **coal or charcoal**.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
